videos.title: Best Free Open Source Backend as a Service Solutions
videos.description: Discover the best free, open-source Backend as a Service (BaaS) solutions for your next web or mobile application. This comparison guide dives into five leading platforms: Appwrite, Directus, Parse, Pocketbase, and Supabase. We evaluate their core features, including…

videos.title: Lesson 8 - Automate With Flows - Onboarding
videos.description: This video demonstrates how to automate tasks and processes within Directus using its Flows feature. It covers setting up and utilizing flows to streamline operations, reduce manual effort, and enhance overall project efficiency within the Directus platform.

videos.title: Build a CRM and Project Tracker with Directus No-code App Data Studio
videos.description: This video demonstrates building a no-code CRM and project tracker using Directus. It covers creating collections, defining fields, configuring formatting and relational details between data, and populating the database to establish a functional application.

videos.title: Learn How Easy it is to Automate Data Processing Tasks in our Directus Flows Overview
videos.description: Learn how to automate data processing and repetitive tasks with Directus Flows, a powerful tool built directly into the Directus platform. This overview explains how to create event-driven workflows for tasks like sending email notifications, updating collections, and…

videos.title: Learn How to Create No-Code Dashboards for Your Database using Directus Insights
videos.description: This video demonstrates creating no-code dashboards with Directus Insights. It covers visualizing data from various sources like backends and headless CMS, detailing how to utilize Directus features such as label, list, metric, time series, and global variable panels.

videos.title: Directus Roles and Permissions, Common Use Cases
videos.description: This video explains Directus roles and permissions, covering granular access control, rule-based configurations, and common use cases. It demonstrates setting up public, custom, and field permissions, managing user roles, and utilizing dynamic variable rules for collections and…

videos.title: Visualize Your Data Better with Directus Layouts: Tables, Cards, Calendars, Maps and Kanban
videos.description: The video demonstrates data visualization in Directus using various layouts. It covers configuring tables, cards, calendars, and maps. Additionally, it explores the Kanban layout, adjusting sizing and sorting, implementing filtering and search, and managing data import/export.

videos.title: Learn How Flows Can Take Your Headless CMS Project to the Next Level
videos.description: This video covers Directus Flows, detailing how to automate tasks and complex processes within a headless CMS using event-based triggers, conditions, and operations to create automated workflows. It also demonstrates how to track data flow through custom logic.

videos.title: Lesson 2 - Customizing Your Data Model - Onboarding
videos.description: This video demonstrates customizing a data model in Directus. It covers creating collections, adding and configuring fields with validation, and establishing relationships between collections to structure data effectively.
